description: We’re Mango’s Gravity, a team of high school engineering students from EJ KOSEN in Egypt who believe that if an apple inspired Newton, a mango can power our next space hack. Combining software, AI, hardware, web dev, and data analysis for this year's NASA Space Apps Challenge, we're convinced Ismailia is secretly the next space tunnel to deep space. When we're not crunching physics or debugging code, we’re busy building real tech and figuring out how to grow tropical fruit in the cosmos.
